ios.desc:
Unleash the power of seamless email management with Mailtemi - the fastest app for IMAP, JMAP, and Gmail. Say goodbye to cluttered inboxes and hello to a unified, organized email experience.

Mailtemi features a smart inbox that categorizes your messages into Primary, Forums, Updates, and Promotions, making it easier for you to prioritize your emails. The app also supports multiple contact sync APIs including CardDAV, Google People, and MS Graph. With native support for Office 365, Outlook, JMAP, and Fastmail, Mailtemi offers fast and efficient email synchronization.

Enjoy exceptional speed and a familiar user interface with Mailtemi. The app uses the latest technology in iOS including C++ and Swift to provide lightning-fast email synchronization. The UI is based on the familiar Mail interface, enhanced with Avatars, Color Coding, and a better Unified Inbox. Mailtemi also features a Dark Mode and Color Coding options, offering a personalized email experience.

Setting up a new account with Mailtemi is a breeze. Simply provide your username, password, and email address, and the app will automatically find the correct settings. With the smart Conversations feature, Mailtemi aggregates all your emails into one conversation, making it easier to manage and perform bulk operations.

Mailtemi is committed to protecting your privacy and security. The app uses advanced security protocols and practices to ensure data integrity and security. All your settings and passwords remain stored on your iPhone, giving you peace of mind.

Join the revolution of efficient and organized email management by downloading Mailtemi now! Connect all your emails to one inbox and take control of your inbox.
